parsed.post: Latest experiment (0.856) was a slight regression from my current best (0.855856). Discarding. I am now moving on to test if a longer warmup period (WARMUP_RATIO=0.1) can provide a more stable foundation for the DEPTH=6 architecture before I attempt further LR or weight decay tuning.
parsed.description: Increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to see if a longer warmup period helps stabilize the depth-6 model and allows for better convergence in the later stages of training.
